welcome: Hello! I'm Kukua, your Corbit X guide. Over the coming months, I'll help you discover what Corbit X means for our customers, branches, and teams. Let's get started.
journeyIntro: Six stops, six guides. Use the arrows or swipe, and I'll tell you what each one is about.
start: Ready? Our first stop is all about account numbers. Let's go!
finish: You've reached the end of the journey. Well done! Come back any time to refresh your knowledge.
closing: Corbit X is more than a system. It's a journey we are taking together. Keep learning, stay informed, and let's prepare for the future.
